messages:
marta: deploy-bot flagged canary instability for user-sync chart v1.8.2 in us-east-1 — 10% canary showing node skew and pod churn, readiness fails. tagging @ryan @sre-oncall. looks related to new zone-affinity defaults in chart bump. rollback or patch overlay?
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10%. Events: FailedScheduling (insufficient) in az-b, ready failures in az-c. (bot)
ryan: the chart 1.8.2 introduced a default podAntiAffinity with topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone which when combined with our staging taints reduces eligible nodes in us-east. overlay didn't override affinity.
alex: quick options: 1) revert chart to 1.8.1 (safe), 2) patch overlay to explicitly set affinity to previous soft-schedule (fast), 3) increase canary to 50% to see if scheduler evens out (risky). I'm for option 2 if we can land in <20m.
sre-oncall: if we patch overlay we should do dry-run first and keep promotion pinned until observed. Rollback is simpler if we need immediate stability.
marta: can we do a dry-run deploy targeting canary with overlay patch? `deploy-bot promote --chart user-sync:1.8.2 --overlay branch/affinity-fix --region us-east-1 --canary 10 --dry-run`
deploy-bot: Dry-run accepted (no changes applied). Template rendering shows overlay sets podAntiAffinity: null (removes chart default).
ryan: I'll open PR for overlay undo of affinity default: https://git.company/repos/platform/changes/pulls/2201 — title: override chart default podAntiAffinity for us-east. CC @marta
alex: CI lint for overlay is green. once merged, run a real canary; if we still see scheduling issues we rollback.
marta: merging overlay PR now. holding promotion window for us-east for 40m to stop cross-region promotion.
deploy-bot: PR merged. Initiating canary: user-sync:1.8.2 in us-east-1 at 10%. Health streaming...
ryan: initial logs show pods scheduling across azs now. readiness probes passing in new pods. pod churn dropped.
sre-oncall: monitoring for 15m steady state. if stable advance to 50% then full.
alex: note: we should add a presubmit check that detects if chart introduces affinity/anti-affinity changes and requires overlay review. filing infra ticket: https://git.company/infra/issues/715
marta: release-bot, please add a blurb to release notes documenting the incident and that we overrode a chart default in overlay for us-east.
release-bot: Added note: "Patched overlay to override new podAntiAffinity default introduced in user-sync v1.8.2 for us-east-1. Canary instability observed due to reduced scheduling capacity in specific AZs. Revert was not required; chart remains v1.8.2. Follow-up: add affinity gate to promotion CI."
ryan: lesson learned — chart-level scheduling defaults can interact badly with our regional overlays. we'll add a checklist item to the promotion runbook.
marta: recap owners: ryan — PR and follow-up ticket, alex — watch promotion & escalate, sre-oncall — monitor during window, release-bot — publish notes. ETA to stable: ~25m.
deploy-bot: Promotion progressed to 50% then 100% with no regressions. promotion window released. :white_check_mark:
